clue.text: Song of cuckoo moved a girl

parts.note: cuckoo is slang for crazy, mad

indicators.note: moved says the letters of the following words are shifted into a new order

explanation.surface: A girl is stirred by the call of a cuckoo, inspiring a song.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cuckoo' suggests the bird, but here it means crazy; 'moved' is the signal to rearrange the two words after it.
explanation.definitionFit: A madrigal is a type of part-song for unaccompanied voices, popular in the Renaissance.

clue.text: Pay attention — this statement is out by a factor of five

parts.words: this statement is out by a factor of five
parts.note: the statement is Roman fifty followed by the words is and ten, a claim wrong by a factor of five

explanation.surface: Someone is told to concentrate because their figures are badly wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: L is the Roman numeral for 50, so the letters split as 'L is ten', a statement that is out by a factor of five.
explanation.definitionFit: To listen is to give heed, the ordinary sense of paying attention to something.

clue.text: Law needs answer before court concerned with body found in Westminster

indicators.note: before puts the first piece ahead of what follows

parts.note: of can mean about or concerning
Parliament sits in the Palace of Westminster in London

explanation.surface: A law requires a reply before a court dealing with a parliamentary body.
explanation.walkthrough: Westminster is the London district housing the UK Parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: A statute passed by Parliament is the formal written law of the land.

clue.text: Memory playing up about name and faces for people, say

indicators.note: about says the rearranged letters wrap around the next piece
playing up means misbehaving, so the letters of memory are jumbled

explanation.surface: A failing memory around names and faces, mixing up people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'playing up' rearranges MEMORY into MEROYM, and 'about' puts N inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A word denoting a part used to stand for the whole is that term; faces standing for people is an example.

clue.text: Small hat is closer to the neck

parts.note: a topper is a top hat

explanation.surface: A little hat sits close to the neck.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'closer' as the noun (a thing that closes), not 'nearer'.
explanation.definitionFit: A cork or bung closes the neck of a bottle, so it is a closer for it.

clue.text: I'm pale — unfortunately one with a concentration of fat in the blood

definitions.text: concentration of fat in the blood

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things have gone awry, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A patient laments looking pale because of too much fat in the blood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfortunately' rearranges IMPALE plus I into LIPAEMI, and A follows.
explanation.definitionFit: The medical term names an abnormally high level of lipids circulating in blood plasma.

clue.text: Canteen providing a piece of tuna — a fillet

indicators.note: piece of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A mess hall serves a portion of tuna fillet.
explanation.walkthrough: NAAFI is the organisation running canteens and shops for British armed forces.
explanation.definitionFit: The forces' organisation is best known for its canteens on military bases.

clue.text: Leave note to dine about ten

indicators.note: about says the first pieces wrap around the next

parts.note: E is a musical note
to dine is to eat
X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: A note requesting dinner at about ten o'clock.
explanation.walkthrough: An exeat is permission to leave, especially from a British boarding school or college.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin-derived word is a formal permission for absence from school or college.

clue.text: Musical piece needs a new ending mostly to make sharper

parts.note: a tip is the end of something

indicators.note: mostly says the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: to hone is to sharpen a blade

explanation.surface: A piece of music needs a fresh finish to sharpen it up.
explanation.definitionFit: An antiphon is a short sung chant, often in responses between two choirs.

clue.text: Rejected unfashionable appearance

parts.note: something out is no longer in fashion
cast can mean look or appearance, as in cast of features

explanation.surface: An unstylish look was turned down.
explanation.definitionFit: A person rejected by society is a pariah, cast out by others.

clue.text: Yielding test success with intravenous dose finally

parts.note: to pass is to succeed in a test

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of dose

explanation.surface: A medical test is passed after an intravenous dose.
explanation.definitionFit: Being yielding means submitting without resistance, which is a submissive, inactive manner.

clue.text: Get in orders after order point, as happens in factory shops

indicators.note: after puts the rearranged words behind the earlier pieces

parts.note: to direct is to order
a mark is a point or spot

indicators.note: orders as a verb means arranges, so the letters are put in a new sequence

explanation.surface: A firm takes in orders after an ordering point, as in factory outlets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'orders' appears to be the noun but works as a verb signalling the rearrangement; the definition describes selling straight to consumers.
explanation.definitionFit: Factory shops sell straight from manufacturer to consumer, cutting out middlemen in selling.

clue.text: Supplier of delivery for hat

definitions.meaning: in cricket the player who delivers the ball
a hard round felt hat, the derby

explanation.definitionFit: In cricket the deliverer of the ball has this name, and it is also a round hard felt hat.

clue.text: Initially reach eastern Cape by ship on which one can relax

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of reach

parts.note: a liner is an ocean-going passenger ship

explanation.surface: A traveller arrives at an eastern cape by ocean steamer.
explanation.definitionFit: A chair whose back tilts lets the sitter lean back and rest comfortably.

clue.text: Note gasman uncovered unpleasant smell

parts.note: mi is a note of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: uncovered strips the outer letters of gasman

explanation.surface: The gas fitter left a note about a bad smell.
explanation.definitionFit: A miasma is a noxious vapour or foul odour.

clue.text: Resolve to prevent tunnelling?

parts.note: to deter is to prevent or discourage
a mine is made by tunnelling

explanation.surface: Someone resolves to stop the digging of tunnels.
explanation.definitionFit: To resolve a matter is to settle or decide it.

clue.text: One northern nut tree initially attracts a Spanish princess

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a nut is an enthusiast, a fan

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of tree

explanation.surface: A northern nut tree catches the eye of a Spanish royal.
explanation.definitionFit: Infanta is the title of a daughter of the king of Spain or Portugal.

clue.text: Winged maiden is a siren, perhaps

parts.note: alar means relating to wings
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A winged maiden is a seductive siren of myth.
explanation.walkthrough: The mythical siren with wings misleads; here a siren is a warning device.
explanation.definitionFit: A siren is one example of a warning device that sounds in danger.

clue.text: I had turned over an American from east of Washington

indicators.note: turned says the word had is read backwards

parts.note: O is the cricket abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: Someone turned an American visitor from beyond Washington over.
explanation.walkthrough: Idaho lies east of Washington State.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of the state that borders Washington on its east side has this name.

clue.text: Idiot losing article in Belgian city

indicators.note: losing says a piece is removed from the city's name

parts.note: Antwerp is a major port city in Belgium
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A fool loses an article somewhere in Belgium.
explanation.definitionFit: A twerp is a silly or annoying person, a fool.

clue.text: New Zealand bird never otherwise found on North Island

parts.note: never means not at all
or means otherwise, as in hurry or you'll miss it

explanation.surface: A New Zealand bird is found nowhere else but North Island.
explanation.walkthrough: The notornis, or takahe, is a flightless New Zealand rail once thought extinct.
explanation.definitionFit: The takahe, a rare flightless rail of New Zealand, has this genus name.

clue.text: Superior individual girl coming in pruned plants

indicators.note: coming in puts the girl inside the cut-down plants
pruned says the end of the word is cut off

parts.note: cacti are spiny desert plants
lass is a girl

explanation.surface: A fine young woman arrives among the trimmed plants.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone of outstanding quality or style is described by this idiom.

clue.text: For the moment, something associated with Greenwich

definitions.meaning: the standard time reckoned at the Greenwich meridian

explanation.walkthrough: Greenwich, in London, gives its name to GMT.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means the interval between, and GMT is Greenwich time of that name.

clue.text: Obtain oil for cooking the chop?

indicators.note: cooking suggests the letters are mixed and prepared afresh

explanation.surface: Getting oil to cook a pork chop.
explanation.walkthrough: The chop here means getting rid of something, not meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving something the chop means axing it, which is ending or doing away with it.

clue.text: Fish in a lot of newspaper for Calais seaman

indicators.note: a lot of means most of, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: Le Monde is a leading French daily newspaper
AB is an able seaman

explanation.surface: A fish wrapped in a French paper for a sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: A lemon dab is a flatfish, also called lemon sole.

clue.text: Unaware state needs to secure hospital block

indicators.note: to secure means to hold within, so the state wraps the next piece

parts.note: a trance is a dazed state with no awareness

explanation.surface: A dazed patient needs to secure a hospital block.
explanation.definitionFit: A tranche is a portion or slice of something, as of shares.

clue.text: Enact EU law initially as a single measure?

parts.note: to pass a bill is to enact it

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of law

explanation.surface: Enacting an EU law as a single regulation.
explanation.walkthrough: A measure is also a dance, so a dance for one fits.
explanation.definitionFit: This ballet term means a solo dance, a step for one dancer.

clue.text: Register left margin on bottom edge of paper

parts.note: an edge is a margin or border

indicators.note: in a down clue the bottom edge is the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: A register's left margin sits on the bottom edge of the page.
explanation.definitionFit: An account book records transactions, so it is a register.

clue.text: Three leaving from front of London airport get confused

indicators.note: says three letters are removed from the start of the airport's name

parts.note: Heathrow is London's main airport

explanation.surface: Three travellers leave London's airport bewildered.
explanation.definitionFit: To throw someone is to disconcert them, so to be thrown is to be bewildered.

clue.text: Atone for parking on drive

parts.note: an urge is a drive or impulse

explanation.surface: A motorist makes amends for parking on someone's driveway.
explanation.definitionFit: To purge a sin is to expiate or cleanse it.
